app.title: Paloma — a modern photo manager (Google Picasa successor)

geo.removeLocationBody_other: Remove the location of {{count, number}} photos? The photo files are not changed.

geo.replaceBody_other: {{count, number}} selected photos already have a location. Replace it?

geo.resolving_other: Looking up the places of {{count, number}} photos…

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add photo filters and other features to Paloma. Switch a plugin on or off at any time.
plugins.externalWarning: External plugins run with full access to this computer. Switch on only plugins you trust.
plugins.installHint: To install a plugin, copy or clone its folder into the plugins folder and restart Paloma.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings are remembered in this browser only.
settings.languageHint: The language of every text in Paloma.
settings.levelHint: How many tools Paloma shows. Choose a lower level for a beginner or a child.
settings.navBarHint: Close, previous and next photo, and zoom.
settings.editBarHint: Undo, redo and the photo fixes, such as crop and rotate.
settings.skinHint: How the screen is built: where the menus are, and how large text and buttons are.
settings.themeHint: Colors only. The layout stays the same.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The original layout with large, labelled buttons.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: More photos on the screen: smaller text and thumbnails, icon buttons, a sidebar you can fold away.

glass.name: Fluid Glass
glass.description: For tablets and touch: photos fill the screen under floating, see-through bars, with large buttons.

system.name: System
system.description: Follows your computer: dark or high contrast when it is set that way.

light.name: Light
light.description: Dark text on a light background.

dark.name: Dark
dark.description: Light text on a dark background, easy on the eyes in a dim room.

high-contrast.name: High Contrast
high-contrast.description: White and bright colors on black, for the clearest text.

viewer.facesUnavailable: Face frames cannot be shown for this photo because of its straightening.
viewer.objectsUnavailable: Object frames cannot be shown for this photo because of its straightening.

tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter

info.title: Info
info.noPeople: No people are named on this photo
info.jsonIni: Read from the Picasa .ini; not yet saved to .paloma.json.
info.jsonNone: This photo has no entry in .paloma.json.

child.name: Child
child.description: Only albums and slideshows; nothing can be changed. Settings need a PIN. This keeps children from changing things by accident, but it is not a security lock.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Albums, folders, search, stars, simple fixes, export and print.

normal.name: Normal
normal.description: Every tool: people, map, collage, movies, plugins and all photo fixes.

pro.name: Professional
pro.description: Everything in Normal, and tools for experienced users as they are added.

developer.name: Developer
developer.description: Everything Paloma and its plugins offer, including tools for developers.

pin.unlockHint: Settings are locked. Enter the PIN to open them.
pin.createHint: Choose a PIN of 4 to 8 digits. It will be needed to open Settings.
pin.invalid: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
pin.mismatch: The PINs differ. Please start again.
pin.wait: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{time}}.

faces.found: Faces found: {{faces, number}}, on {{photos, number}} photos.
faces.failed: Photos that could not be checked: {{failed, number}}.
faces.nothingToDo: Faces on these photos have already been found.
faces.noReferenceTitle: No faces of {{name}} to compare with yet
faces.noReferenceHint: Run “Find faces” on the photos of {{name}}, then come back here.
faces.noSimilarHint: Run “Find faces” on more folders to find more photos of {{name}}.
faces.faceHint: Click to select; double-click to open the photo
faces.noUnrecognizedHint: Every face found so far belongs to someone. Run “Find faces” on more folders to find new ones.
faces.assignFailed: Faces that could not be saved: {{failed, number}}. Their folders cannot be written.

auth.serverError: Cannot reach the Paloma server. Check that it is running, then try again.
auth.loginIntro: Log in to see the photos.
auth.noProviders: No way to log in is switched on. Ask the person who runs Paloma.
auth.setupIntro: Paloma has no users yet. The setup code is in the server's log. The administrator you create here can add everyone else.
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
auth.changePasswordIntro: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose a new one that only you know.

account.title: Account
account.loggedInAs: You are logged in as {{name}} ({{username}}), with the role {{role}}.
account.passwordChanged: The password has been changed. Your other devices have been logged out.
account.sessionsHint: Where you are logged in. Log out a device you do not use or do not recognize.
account.tokensHint: Let scripts and other apps use Paloma as you, with only the permissions you choose. Send a token as “Authorization: Bearer <token>”.
account.tokenExpiresHint: Leave empty for a token that does not expire.
account.tokenCreated: Copy the token now. It will not be shown again.
account.avatarHint: A picture of you for the user menu. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB.
account.noPerson: You are not linked with a person in the library.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Users, their roles and what they see, and the ways to log in.

users.deleteConfirm: Delete {{username}}? Their sessions and tokens end at once. Their exported files stay in the export folder on disk.
users.initialPasswordHint: The user must choose their own password at the first login.
users.resetHint: {{username}} is logged out and must choose their own password at the next login.
users.passwordReset: The password of {{username}} has been reset.

access.title: Library access
access.adminAll: Users with the right to manage users always see the whole library.
access.noneChosen: Nothing is chosen, so this user sees no photos.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.exportHint: Space for this user's exports and movies, in megabytes. Empty for no limit.
quotas.rateHint: API requests per minute; images do not count. Empty for the server's default. 0 means no limit.

auth.intro: Ways to log in come from plugins. Switch them on and off in Server settings, in the Plugins section.
auth.none: No plugin with a way to log in is switched on.

server.title: Server settings
server.intro: Settings of the Paloma server. They apply to every user and every browser.
server.envHint: These values come from the server's .env file. Change them there and restart the server.
server.sessionDays: Days a login lasts without use
server.mcpToken: AI clients connect with a personal API token (Account → API tokens).
server.mcpNoToken: No token is needed while users are off.

ai.title: AI
ai.intro: AI tasks look at photos to add tags, find objects or write descriptions. Choose a provider and a model for each task. These settings apply to every user.

problem.no_provider: Choose a provider for this task.
problem.provider_unavailable: Its provider is not available. Switch on its plugin in the Plugins section.
problem.provider_not_configured: Its provider is not set up yet.
problem.no_model: Choose a model for this task.
problem.model_disabled: Its model is disabled. Enable it in the provider's models, or choose another model.

providers.title: Providers
providers.none: No AI provider is available. Switch on an AI plugin, such as OpenAI, in the Plugins section.
providers.privacy: Photos processed with {{name}} are sent to its service.
providers.privacyAddress: Photos processed with {{name}} are sent to {{address}}.
providers.fromEnv: The server's environment gives this while nothing is saved here.
providers.pluginOff: The plugin of this provider is off. Its settings and models are kept; switch the plugin on in the Plugins section to use it.
providers.name: Name
providers.deleteBody: Delete {{name}} with its settings and models? Its usage records stay. A provider that a task uses cannot be deleted.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: The AI menus offer these tasks. After a change of a task's provider, model, prompt, model options, image size or language, it processes photos again.
tasks.resetBody: Its prompt and options go back to their defaults. Its provider and model stay.
tasks.deleteBody: Its results are deleted too. Tags and descriptions it added to photos stay.

editor.name: Name
editor.modelsFailed: The models could not be listed: {{message}} You can type a model name.

placeholder.language: the name of the answer language
placeholder.libraryTags: the 300 tags used most in the library

option.imageSizeHelp: The long edge of the image sent. A larger image shows more detail and costs more.
option.languageUser: The language of whoever runs it
option.minConfidenceHelp: From 0 to 1. Less confident answers are kept as results but not added to photos.
option.labelsAsTags: Also add object names as tags

target.description-if-empty: The description, when the photo has none
target.description-always: The description, replacing the current one

menu.label: AI tasks for these photos

models.notListed: No longer listed by the service

keys.settingsHint: Which keys run which actions. Your keymap is kept on the server, so it is the same in every browser you use.
